title: Agata no Mori Cultural Center — Matsumoto City Official Tourism Website

facts.fact: The Cultural Center preserves a wooden Western-style school building associated with Matsumoto High School, opened in1919, and designated an Important Cultural Property.
facts.excerpt: Matsumoto High School, which opened in 1919.

facts.fact: The cultural building has its own opening calendar, including Monday and holiday closures, separate from the surrounding park.

notes: Official page actually fetched and the named passages read; raw response and extracted text retained outside Git. Route choices and priorities are original editorial advice. No personal visit, demand ranking, guaranteed mountain view, price or timetable is claimed.
